passages.text: One who scatters advances against you, O Nineveh. Guard the fortress! Watch the road! Brace yourselves! Summon all your strength!
passages.sermon:
Nineveh faces a new enemy.
This enemy scatters and destroys.
Prepare to defend your city.
Guard your fortress well.
Watch the road carefully.
Strengthen your resolve.
Gather all your strength.
passages.original: עָלָ֥ה מֵפִ֛יץ עַל־ פָּנַ֖יִךְ נָצ֣וֹר מְצֻרָ֑ה צַפֵּה־ דֶ֙רֶךְ֙ חַזֵּ֣ק מָתְנַ֔יִם אַמֵּ֥ץ כֹּ֖חַ מְאֹֽד׃

passages.text: For the LORD will restore the splendor of Jacob like the splendor of Israel, though destroyers have laid them waste and ruined the branches of their vine.
passages.sermon:
The LORD is the God of Israel.
The LORD will restore the splendor of Jacob.
Jacob is another name for the people of Israel.
The LORD will make Jacob glorious again.
Jacob’s splendor will be like the splendor of Israel.
Enemies destroyed Jacob’s land.
Destroyers ruined the branches of Jacob’s vine.
Even though destroyers brought destruction, the LORD will restore Jacob’s glory.
passages.original: כִּ֣י שָׁ֤ב יְהוָה֙ אֶת־ גְּא֣וֹן יַעֲקֹ֔ב כִּגְא֖וֹן יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל כִּ֤י בְקָקוּם֙ בֹּֽקְקִ֔ים וּזְמֹרֵיהֶ֖ם שִׁחֵֽתוּ׃

passages.text: The shields of his mighty men are red; the valiant warriors are dressed in scarlet. The fittings of the chariots flash like fire on the day they are prepared, and the spears of cypress have been brandished.
passages.sermon:
The mighty men of Nineveh carry red shields.
The warriors wear scarlet clothing.
The chariots have metal fittings that shine like fire when they are ready for battle.
The soldiers brandish spears made from cypress wood.
passages.original: מָגֵ֨ן גִּבֹּרֵ֜יהוּ מְאָדָּ֗ם אַנְשֵׁי־ חַ֙יִל֙ מְתֻלָּעִ֔ים בְּאֵשׁ־ פְּלָד֥וֹת הָרֶ֖כֶב בְּי֣וֹם הֲכִינ֑וֹ וְהַבְּרֹשִׁ֖ים הָרְעָֽלוּ׃

passages.text: The chariots dash through the streets; they rush around the plazas, appearing like torches, darting about like lightning.
passages.sermon:
Chariots move quickly in the streets.
They rush through the plazas.
The chariots look like burning torches.
They dart about like flashes of lightning.
passages.original: בַּֽחוּצוֹת֙ יִתְהוֹלְל֣וּ הָרֶ֔כֶב יִֽשְׁתַּקְשְׁק֖וּן בָּרְחֹב֑וֹת מַרְאֵיהֶן֙ כַּלַּפִּידִ֔ם כַּבְּרָקִ֖ים יְרוֹצֵֽצוּ׃

passages.text: He summons his nobles; they stumble as they advance. They race to its wall; the protective shield is set in place.
passages.sermon:
The Lord attacks Nineveh.
He calls his nobles.
The nobles stumble as they move forward.
They hurry to the city wall.
Soldiers set up the protective shield.
passages.original: יִזְכֹּר֙ אַדִּירָ֔יו יִכָּשְׁל֖וּ בַהֲלִכוֹתָם יְמַֽהֲרוּ֙ חֽוֹמָתָ֔הּ וְהֻכַ֖ן הַסֹּכֵֽךְ׃

passages.text: The river gates are thrown open and the palace collapses.
passages.sermon: The river gates open wide.\r\nThe palace falls down.

passages.text: It is decreed that the city be exiled and carried away; her maidservants moan like doves, and beat upon their breasts.
passages.sermon:
God decrees that the city must go into exile.
The city will be carried away.
The city's maidservants mourn.
They sound like doves when they moan.
They beat on their breasts in sorrow.
passages.original: וְהֻצַּ֖ב גֻּלְּתָ֣ה הֹֽעֲלָ֑תָה וְאַמְהֹתֶ֗יהָ מְנַֽהֲגוֹת֙ כְּק֣וֹל יוֹנִ֔ים מְתֹפְפֹ֖ת עַל־ לִבְבֵהֶֽן׃

passages.text: Nineveh has been like a pool of water throughout her days, but now it is draining away. “Stop! Stop!” they cry, but no one turns back.
passages.sermon:
Nineveh is a city.
Nineveh has been calm and full, like a pool of water, for many years.
Now Nineveh is emptying.
People are fleeing from Nineveh.
Some shout, “Stop! Stop!”
No one listens.
No one returns.
passages.original: וְנִינְוֵ֥ה כִבְרֵֽכַת־ מַ֖יִם מִ֣ימֵי הִ֑יא וְהֵ֣מָּה נָסִ֔ים עִמְד֥וּ עֲמֹ֖דוּ וְאֵ֥ין מַפְנֶֽה׃

passages.text: “Plunder the silver! Plunder the gold!” There is no end to the treasure, an abundance of every precious thing.
passages.sermon:
The people shout, “Plunder the silver!”
They also shout, “Plunder the gold!”
There is no end to the treasure.
There is an abundance of every precious thing.
passages.original: בֹּ֥זּוּ כֶ֖סֶף בֹּ֣זּוּ זָהָ֑ב וְאֵ֥ין קֵ֙צֶה֙ לַתְּכוּנָ֔ה כָּבֹ֕ד מִכֹּ֖ל כְּלִ֥י חֶמְדָּֽה׃

passages.text: She is emptied! Yes, she is desolate and laid waste! Hearts melt, knees knock, bodies tremble, and every face grows pale!
passages.sermon:
Nineveh is now empty.
She is desolate.
She is laid waste.
The people’s hearts melt with fear.
Their knees knock together.
Their bodies tremble.
Every face grows pale.
passages.original: בּוּקָ֥ה וּמְבוּקָ֖ה וּמְבֻלָּקָ֑ה וְלֵ֨ב נָמֵ֜ס וּפִ֣ק בִּרְכַּ֗יִם וְחַלְחָלָה֙ בְּכָל־ מָתְנַ֔יִם וּפְנֵ֥י כֻלָּ֖ם קִבְּצ֥וּ פָארֽוּר׃

passages.text: Where is the lions’ lair or the feeding ground of the young lions, where the lion and lioness prowled with their cubs, with nothing to frighten them away?
passages.sermon:
The prophet Nahum speaks about Nineveh.
Nineveh was a powerful and violent city.
He asks, “Where is the lions’ lair?”
He asks, “Where is the place where young lions fed?”
Lions once walked there.
The lioness also walked there.
Their cubs lived there too.
No one made them afraid.
They lived without fear.
passages.original: אַיֵּה֙ מְע֣וֹן אֲרָי֔וֹת וּמִרְעֶ֥ה ה֖וּא לַכְּפִרִ֑ים אֲשֶׁ֣ר הָלַךְ֩ אַרְיֵ֨ה לָבִ֥יא שָׁ֛ם גּ֥וּר אַרְיֵ֖ה וְאֵ֥ין מַחֲרִֽיד׃

passages.text: The lion mauled enough for its cubs and strangled prey for the lioness. It filled its dens with the kill, and its lairs with mauled prey.
passages.sermon:
The lion is a fierce hunter.
The lion kills prey for its cubs.
The lion strangles prey for the lioness.
The lion fills its dens with the animals it kills.
The lion fills its lairs with mauled prey.
passages.original: אַרְיֵ֤ה טֹרֵף֙ בְּדֵ֣י גֹֽרוֹתָ֔יו וּמְחַנֵּ֖ק לְלִבְאֹתָ֑יו וַיְמַלֵּא־ טֶ֣רֶף חֹרָ֔יו וּמְעֹֽנֹתָ֖יו טְרֵפָֽה׃

passages.text: “Behold, I am against you,” declares the LORD of Hosts. “I will send your chariots up in smoke, and the sword will devour your young lions. I will cut off your prey from the earth, and the voices of your messengers will no longer be heard.”
passages.sermon:
The LORD of Hosts speaks.
He says, “I am against you.”
I will burn your chariots with fire.
Smoke will rise from them.
The sword will kill your young lions.
I will remove your prey from the earth.
No one will hear the voices of your messengers again.
passages.original: הִנְנִ֣י אֵלַ֗יִךְ נְאֻם֙ יְהוָ֣ה צְבָא֔וֹת וְהִבְעַרְתִּ֤י בֶֽעָשָׁן֙ רִכְבָּ֔הּ וּכְפִירַ֖יִךְ תֹּ֣אכַל חָ֑רֶב וְהִכְרַתִּ֤י מֵאֶ֙רֶץ֙ טַרְפֵּ֔ךְ וְלֹֽא־ יִשָּׁמַ֥ע ע֖וֹד ק֥וֹל מַלְאָכֵֽכֵה׃ס
